caption_L1: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development (GERD) as a percentage of GDP in Denmark from 2001 to 2017 is a bar plot. There is a linear scale of range 0.000 to 0.035 along the x-axis, labeled GERD as percentage of GDP. A categorical scale from 2001 to 2017* can be seen along the y-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: From 2001 to 2006 you can see that the gross domestic expenditure on research was up and down but in 2009 it was the best year as a percentage whole as it was over the mark. But from 2010 onwards it managed to keep relatively neutral by dropping slight in 2010-11 but the percentage rose onwards from then.
